plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Mathematics Education program page (poid=10879) and its linked official degree map, 'Mathematics & Mathematics Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Math Education (Campus)' (the workbook's Index lists Online as N/A for this program), last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (16/16/16/14/15/16/15/12) and the plan to the catalog's printed totals, Total Credits, BS Degree: 120 and Total Credits, BS Degree with Licensure: 120; the map includes the full licensure course set and both catalog totals are 120, so there is no licensure shortfall. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to be counted in the major. The map exercises every course the catalog lists: the Core Requirements items, the Teacher Education Courses (MATH 4900 and MATH 4980), and the Professional Education Requirements — the Pre-Admission Courses (with the catalog's 'Academic 3900/4900 Methods Course(s)' exercised through the major's MATH 4900, which the catalog's footnote counts only once), the Block Courses (SCED 3570 and SCED 3590), and the Advanced Teacher Education Program Courses (EDUC 4930, with student teaching exercised as MATH 4980). The upper-division MATH elective is the map's 'MATH Major Upper-division Elective* (MATH 3040 rec.)' row, carrying the catalog's wording. SCED 3180 is catalogued at 2-3 credits and is placed by the map at 2 credits, the value recorded. The map's Spring Year 1 'GE Physical Sciences*' row is recorded at the printed 5 credits; the catalog and the map both recommend PHYS 2210 and PHYS 2215 for that area. The map's Fall Year 3 'Apply to College of Education Teacher Preparation Program' marker is not a course row. DISCLOSED catalog heading error and catalog-vs-map difference, transcribed as printed and not reconciled: (1) the catalog heads the Core Requirements at 43 credits, but its fourteen listed core items sum to 46 credits, so the Curriculum's listed items sum to 58 against the printed Curriculum heading of 55 credits (43 + Teacher Education Courses 12); the catalog degree totals and the map reconcile exactly at 120, so the plan is recorded at 120 with the header error disclosed. (2) The catalog prints MATH 3700 Probability and Statistics at 4 credits while the map prints it at 3 credits in Fall Year 3, the value recorded here and the value at which that term sums to its printed 15; at the map value the recorded core items sum to 45 credits. The catalog's BS (12) and GE (28+) blocks overlap the major and free electives per the catalog's own notes, so the catalog blocks do not sum arithmetically to 120; the map's free-elective rows total 11 credits as printed. Catalog course titles are recorded where the map shortens them (e.g. MATH 3050 Numbers and Statistics for Teaching Secondary Mathematics and EDUC 2400 Schools, Society, and Diversity).
